title: Page 5
content_zh:
================================================================
坐在掌尚勇对面，保贝儿终于见识到什么叫「食量大」，一份日式和风牛井、一份韩式牛柳、一份猪排，一份义大利面，外加一只单点鸡腿……还有她点的蜜汁烧肉简餐有一半也进了他的肚子里。
她一度以为他要呼朋唤发一同来享用才会点这么多，但当他把所有餐点都送入肚后，她傻眼了。
「你，还饿吗？」这些肉，大概是她一个月的「食肉量」，而他，居然一餐就嗑完。
好在他是男的，要是女的，大概没人敢娶他，光吃一顿饭就会被他吃垮了。
「够了，我现在都待办公室。没时问冲浪，运动量不大，还是不要吃太饱。」
第2章(2)
不要吃太饱？吃了这么多，还说「不要吃太饱」！她真不敢想像会让他吃饱的餐点，需要摆几桌才够。
「保俊，你不要跟我容气，你吃那么少怎么会饱？」瞄了对方的餐盘一眼，那点份量，还不够他塞牙缝，而他居然说他吃不下，还分一半给他吃。「你今天若是没吃饱，我可是不会放你走的。」
「我真的吃不下，饱了，真的！」她举手发誓。
「如果你真不想吃，我不勉强。」他无所谓耸肩。「知不知道我为了找你，打了好几通电话，好在以前国小同学，现在很多都是和我们天信集团有往来的集团小开，我问了好几个人，终于有人知道你的手机号码。」
端起咖啡杯，他大口喝着。
「哦。」糟，他们的国小同学，她一个也不认识。父亲让哥哥上贵族小学，而她跟着母亲。能缴得出学费上一般学校，她就要谢天谢地了。
「我听说……」顿了下，他似乎在斟酌喉间的话该不该说出口，片刻后，他直言。「你原本在你父亲的公司担任总经理，公司倒闭后，你就消失了。」
「嗯。」不知道他了解多少，言多必失，保贝儿决定能不说就不说。
「我想不是你消失，而是那些人不想和你联络。」他冷嗤了声。告诉他保俊手机号码的那位同学「好心」提醒他，保俊家公司倒闭了，言语间充斥讥笑，还断言保俊应该是「跑路」了。
之前他虽然只是挂名天信集团首席财务总监，但商场上的事，他太了了，每个和你称兄道弟的，无不是想从你身上挖到一点好处。若今天天信集团倒闭，他想，那些喊他「同学」喊得亲昵无比的家伙，肯定也会像嘲笑保俊般恶劣讥讽他一番。
他掌尚勇最讨厌那种人，若不是想找保俊，他绝不会主动和他们联络。
保贝儿懂他在说什么。从哥哥被撞至今，也没见过有哪个「以前」的朋友来探望过哥哥，可见父亲的公司倒闭后，就没有人和哥哥保持联络。
商场上不就是如此，有钱合作就是朋友，没钱就避不见面，最好老死不相往来。

不过，他似乎对那些人很不以为然。
「你目前有其他的工作吗？」掌尚勇关切询问，就算有，也要把保俊挖过来。
「没……没有。」
「那你是答应当我的特助？」他眉开眼笑，喜怒哀乐一目了然。
她点头。
「我知道让你当特助或许你会觉得委屈些……」毕竞，他当过总经理。「不过，如果这段期间你表现得好，等我大哥回来，我可以向他推荐你，让他安排适合你的职务。」
「不，不用了！」她忙摇手。她是捏陶的，硬着头皮来当总裁特助她自个儿都觉得心虚，更逸论当主管人员。「你愿意给我工作，我已经很感激了。」
「我才要感谢你咧，小学时，老师常说我们一个是武状元、一个是文状元，打球、打架我最在行，但要我写功课简直要我的命，还好有你偷偷帮我写作业，那时我就跟你说，长大后我如果开公司，就要请你来当主管——你记不记得？」
「呃，对。你好像有这么说过。」
「还有啊，我记得有一次……」
吃完饭后的一个钟头，掌尚勇一直在跟「他」叙旧，他说的她当然完全没印象，只能以「对，你好像有这么说过」、「是有这么一回事」、「没错，我记得」、要不，就是用「这件事我没印象」来搪塞。
聊着聊着，从一开始紧张怕穿帮，到后来她倒是听出兴趣，一来，可以知道以前哥哥读小学的趣事；二来，她发现他高壮吓人的外表下，有一颗赤子之心，他活脱脱是个大男孩，说话挺有趣的，除了偶尔爆粗话吓得她想去捂住他的嘴，免得招来旁桌客人异样的眼光这小缺点外。
这一声，吃得很开心，闲聊间，他又点了一份松饼，当作是饭后点心。
对于他的胃能装下这么多食物，她由衷的佩服他。
=========================================================
回到家里，已经十二点，把两大袋衣服放在一旁，保贝儿累得躺在沙发上休息。
吃完晚餐后，掌尚勇又带她去天信百货，一来视察，二来他觉得她的西装外套太大件不合身，所以带她去买西装外套，因为担心穿帮，专拒小姐想帮她量身、帮她试穿，她一概拒绝，随便拿了几件自己试穿，虽然还是太大，但她硬说oK，他只好顺她的意。
逛了一圈后，她想上洗手间差点走到女厕，原以为他会起疑，没想到他竟然很慎重的问她是不是「同志」，因为他观察「他」好久，觉得「他」真的很娘。
当时她呆住。哪有人说话这么直的！当「他」的面，说「他」很娘。
他说，他尊重每个人的性向。他也不会因为「他」是同志，就排斥「他」，不过，他极其慎重的声明，他不是同志。他爱的是女人，仿佛担心「他」会爱上他。

一想到他那时严肃的表情，保贝儿不禁噗嗤笑出声，她不只觉得他有趣，也觉得他很可爱哦。
其实他误以为「他」是同志，这反倒帮了她，有时她会不自觉做出女性化的举动，明明理了平头，下意识还是想拨头发，做出把头发塞向耳后的动作……如果「他」是同志，这一切的行为皆可合理化，他自然不会起疑。
只是这样一来，对哥哥抱歉哪了点，让别人误以为他是同志，但为了十万块的月薪，只得让哥哥委屈一点。
不知道今天哥哥的情况有无好一点？
咳了声，清清喉咙，为了装「男声」，她一直压低声音，真不好受，她也担心自己若长期变声下去，她原先美妙清脆的声音会不会变成唐老鸭？
多喝水吧！
正想起身去找水喝，母亲突然推开房门走出来，把她吓了一跳，看母亲的表情，显然受的惊吓不比她小。
「你……你是谁？」见「陌生人」在屋里，林湘云吓得全身发抖。
「妈！妈，是我，贝儿，我吓到你了，对不起。」
「贝儿？」定睛细看，眼前的这张脸还真的是贝儿，可是……「贝儿，你的头发，还有你的眉毛为什么画那么粗？你……你为芳什么穿你哥的西装？」
林湘云惊恐的捂着嘴，双手颤抖的攀住女儿的肩磅。「贝儿，你还好吧？」
「我没事，不过我好渴，想喝水。」

================================================================
Sitting across from Zhang Shangyong, Bao Beier finally saw what it means to eat a lot. One portion of Japanese-style beef ribs, one portion of Korean beef tenderloin, one portion of pork chop, one portion of pasta, plus an a la carte chicken drumstick... and half of the honey-glazed roast pork meal she ordered also went into his stomach.
She once thought that he would order so much because he wanted to invite all his friends to enjoy it with him, but when he finished all the meals, she was dumbfounded.
"Are you still hungry?" This meat was probably her "meat consumption" for a month, and he actually finished it in one meal.
Fortunately, he is a man. If she were a woman, probably no one would dare to marry him. She would be eaten up by him after just one meal.
"That's enough, I'm staying at the office now. I don't have time to surf, and I don't do much exercise. It's better not to eat too much."
Chapter 2(2)
Don't eat too much? After eating so much, he still said "don't eat too much"! She really couldn't imagine how many tables would need to be set up for a meal that would satisfy him.
"Baojun, don't be arrogant to me. How can you be full after eating so little?" He glanced at the other person's plate. The portion was not enough to fit between his teeth, but he actually said he couldn't eat it and gave him half of it. "If you don't have enough to eat today, I won't let you go."
"I really can't eat, I'm full, really!" She raised her hands and swore.
"If you really don't want to eat, I won't force you." He shrugged nonchalantly. "Did you know that I made several phone calls to find you? Fortunately, many of my former elementary school classmates are now small business owners who have dealings with our Tianxin Group. I asked several people and finally someone knew your mobile phone number."
He picked up the coffee cup and took a sip.
"Oh." Oh no, she didn't know any of their elementary school classmates. Her father sent her brother to a noble primary school, while she followed her mother. She would be thankful if she could afford to attend a regular school.
"I heard..." After a pause, he seemed to be considering whether to speak the words in his throat. After a moment, he spoke bluntly. "You were originally the general manager of your father's company. After the company closed down, you disappeared."
"Hmm." I don't know how much he knows. Talking too much will lead to mistakes. Bao Beier decided not to say anything if he could.
"I think it's not that you disappeared, but that those people didn't want to contact you." He sneered coldly. The classmate who gave him Baojun's mobile phone number "kindly" reminded him that Baojun's company had closed down. His words were full of ridicule and he also asserted that Baojun should have "run away."
Although he was only the chief financial director of Tianxin Group in name before, he was too good at business matters in the market. Everyone who is your brother-in-law wants to get some benefits from you. If Tianxin Group went bankrupt today, he thought, those guys who called him "classmate" so affectionately would definitely mock him as badly as they mocked Baojun.
He, Zhang Shangyong, hates that kind of people the most. If he didn't want to find Baojun, he would never take the initiative to contact them.
Bao Beier knew what he was talking about. From the time my brother was hit, I haven't seen any "former" friends come to visit my brother. It can be seen that after my father's company closed down, no one has kept in touch with my brother.
Isn't it like this in the shopping mall? If you have money, you will become a friend if you cooperate. If you don't have money, you can't avoid seeing each other. It's best not to have contact with each other until death.
However, he seemed very unimpressed with those people.
"Do you have any other jobs at the moment?" Zhang Shangyong asked with concern. Even if you did, he would recruit Baojun.
"No...no."
"Then you agree to be my special assistant?" He smiled brightly, and his emotions and sorrows were clear at a glance.
She nodded.
"I know you may feel aggrieved by having you be a special assistant..." After all, he had been a general manager. "However, if you behave well during this period, when my elder brother comes back,I can recommend you to him and let him arrange a position suitable for you. "
"No, no need!" She waved her hand. She was a coward, and she felt guilty even if she had the courage to become the president's special assistant, and she even talked about becoming a supervisor. "I'm very grateful that you're willing to work for me."
"I just want to thank you. When I was in elementary school, my teacher often said that one of us was the top scholar in martial arts and the other was the top scholar in literature. I was the best at playing ball and fighting, but it was killing me to do my homework. Fortunately, you secretly helped me with my homework. I told you at that time that if I opened a company when I grew up, I would ask you to be the supervisor - do you remember?"
"Uh, yes. You seem to have said that."
"Also, I remember one time..."
For an hour after finishing the meal, Zhang Shangyong kept reminiscing with "him". Of course, she had no memory of what he said. She could only explain it by saying, "Yes, you seem to have said that," "Yes, I remember it," or "I have no memory of it."
As they chatted, she was nervous and afraid of getting involved in the gang at the beginning, but then she became interested. Firstly, she could know the interesting stories about her brother's previous studies in elementary school. Secondly, she discovered that under his tall and scary appearance, he had an innocent heart. He was just like a big boy, and his words were quite interesting. Except for the occasional swear words that scared her, she wanted to cover his mouth to avoid attracting strange looks from the guests at the table next to him.
This time, he was very happy with his meal. During the chat, he ordered another waffle as an after-dinner snack.
She sincerely admired him for being able to hold so much food in his stomach.
=========================================================
When I got home, it was already twelve o'clock. I put the two big bags of clothes aside and Bao Beier was so tired that she lay down on the sofa to rest.
After dinner, Zhang Shangyong took her to Tianxin Department Store for inspection. Secondly, he felt that her suit jacket was too big and did not fit her, so he took her to buy a suit jacket. Because she was worried about wearing it, Miss Zhuanjiu wanted to help her measure it and try it on for her. She refused and just took a few pieces to try on herself. Although it was still too big, she insisted that it was OK, so he had to comply with her wishes.
After walking around, she wanted to use the restroom and almost walked to the women's restroom. She thought he would be suspicious, but to her surprise, he asked her very carefully if she was "gay" because he had observed "him" for a long time and felt that "he" was really girly.
At that time she was stunned. How can anyone speak so directly! In front of "him", saying "him" is very girly.
He said he respects everyone's sexuality. He would not exclude "him" just because "he" was a gay, but he made an extremely cautious statement that he was not a gay. He loves women, as if he is worried that "he" will fall in love with him.
Thinking of his serious expression at that time, Bao Beier couldn't help but laugh out loud. Not only did she think he was funny, she also thought he was cute.
In fact, he mistakenly thought that "he" was a gay, which actually helped her. Sometimes she would unconsciously make feminine behaviors. Even though she had a crew cut, she subconsciously wanted to brush her hair and tuck it behind her ears... If "he" was a gay, all these behaviors could be rationalized and he would naturally not be suspicious.
It's just that in this way, I'm sorry for my brother, so that others mistakenly think that he is a gay, but for the sake of a monthly salary of 100,000 yuan, I have to make my brother feel a little aggrieved.
I wonder if my brother's situation is better today?
She coughed and cleared her throat. In order to pretend to be a "male voice", she kept lowering her voice. It was really uncomfortable. She was also worried that if her voice continued to change for a long time, would her original beautiful and crisp voice turn into that of Donald Duck?
Drink more water!
Just as she was about to get up and look for water, her mother suddenly opened the door and walked out, startling her. Looking at her mother's expression, it was obvious that she was no less frightened than she was.
"You...who are you?Seeing the "stranger" in the house, Lin Xiangyun was so frightened that his whole body trembled.
"Mom! Mom, it's me, Belle, I scared you, I'm sorry."
"Belle?" Looking carefully, the face in front of me is really Belle, but... "Belle, why are your hair and eyebrows so thick? You... why are you wearing your brother's suit?"
Lin Xiangyun covered her mouth in horror and grabbed her daughter's shoulders with trembling hands. "Belle, are you okay?"
"I'm fine, but I'm very thirsty and want to drink water."
